bull_case: Performance advertising is shifting toward AI-driven automated bidding and attribution. Axon, MAX, Adjust and Wurl position APP across demand, monetization and measurement while e-commerce/CTV expand the addressable market.
bear_case: Digital advertising remains intensely competitive and exposed to Apple/Google platform rules. Current growth could normalize as hyperscale platforms copy model improvements or restrict data access.
thesis: APP is a structural leader in AI-driven performance advertising. Revenue growth accelerated while margins expanded, indicating share gain rather than merely industry beta. Axon is paired with distribution/monetization products and expansion beyond gaming, giving multiple growth axes. The main durability constraint is platform dependence: Apple, Google and privacy regulators can reshape targeting economics, while Meta/Google/Amazon can respond with their own AI systems.

evidence.claim: FY2025 revenue grew 70% to $5.481B and H1 2026 revenue grew 56% to $3.766B.
Management identifies Axon AI as the core advertising recommendation system and continues to invest in model improvements.
APP is expanding advertising solutions outside gaming into e-commerce and CTV.
Q3 guidance implies continued sequential growth at roughly 83% adjusted EBITDA margin.

counterevidence: Apple and Google have substantial control over mobile distribution, identifiers and privacy rules.
Meta, Google and Amazon have larger first-party data ecosystems and AI budgets.
Current margins may embed unusually favorable mix and rapid Axon share gains.
Growth outside gaming is less mature than the core mobile-ad business.
unknowns: Long-run share of global performance ad spend.
Regulatory impact on AI targeting and attribution.

uncertainties.rationale: AI-driven performance allocation and digital commerce advertising are durable structural trends.
Growth and margin outcomes strongly support leadership, though precise market share is not disclosed.
Platform and privacy-policy dependence remain meaningful external constraints.

falsifiers: Revenue growth falls to industry-like rates while major rivals gain share.
Platform/privacy changes cause sustained deterioration in advertiser performance.
E-commerce/CTV fail to become material growth contributors.

key_kpis.name: Revenue growth
key_kpis.threshold: Remain materially above digital-ad market growth

key_kpis.name: FCF / EBITDA margin
key_kpis.threshold: High cash conversion persists as scale rises

subscores.rationale: AI automation and performance advertising are long-duration structural shifts.
APP is setting a high performance and profitability benchmark in independent adtech.
Multiple verticals buffer demand, but platform and regulatory dependence remain real.
